Only the runtime\'s own internet traffic goes through Tor. Your phone\'s link to the runtime doesn\'t.
Web traffic and name lookups go through Tor. Everything else, such as UDP and IPv6, is dropped, even if Tor stops.
Calls, video chat and some games need UDP. Many banks, sign-ups and sites block or challenge Tor.
